note: Fictional reviews for the demo site.

reviews.author: Hanne
reviews.text: We saw the aurora on two of our three nights, once from the hot tub. The sauna by the shore is worth the cold walk.

reviews.author: Tomasz
reviews.text: Beautiful place and very warm inside. The road from the ferry is narrow in winter, so take your time.

reviews.author: Kari
reviews.text: Skis on at the door, back for waffles by the fire. The drying room was a gift with two kids.

reviews.author: Lukas
reviews.text: Rowed out on a calm evening and caught dinner. The window table is the best seat on Senja.

reviews.author: Emma
reviews.text: Tiny but perfect for two. You hear the water under the floor at night.

reviews.author: Sigrid
reviews.text: Came for the blossom, stayed for the long dinners. Our dog loved the fenced garden.

reviews.author: Jonas
reviews.text: No signal, a wood stove and a lake full of stars. Bring a good head torch for the path.
